Using the correct discriminant \(9n\):
\[
a_n=\frac{-\sqrt n+\sqrt{9n}}2=\frac{-\sqrt n+3\sqrt n}{2}=\sqrt n.
\]
Thus
\[
S=\sum_{i=1}^{2024}\frac1{a_i}=\sum_{i=1}^{2024}\frac1{\sqrt i}.
\]
Since \(1/\sqrt{x}\) is decreasing,
\[
S>\int_1^{2025}x^{-1/2}\,dx=2(\sqrt{2025}-1)=88,
\]
and
\[
S<1+\int_1^{2024}x^{-1/2}\,dx=2\sqrt{2024}-1<2\cdot45-1=89.
\]
So \(88<S<89\), and the largest integer not exceeding \(S\) is
\[
\boxed{88}.
\]
